title: LP Giobbi, Steve Angello, Bob Moses & More Set to Headline We Belong Here in Central Park
summary: The fest returns to the Park's Wollman Rink this Oct. 2-4.
contentText:
The third year of We Belong Here’s Central Park edition has announced the headliners for its event in early October.

Friday, October 2 will see headlining sets from MEDUZA³, which is a hybrid live concept from the Italian trio Meduza, along with LP Giobbi, who will play a sunset hour show. Saturday, October 3 will feature German producer Ben Böhmer and a live show from fellow German artist Stephan Bodzin, while Sunday, Oct. 4 will feature Swedish mainstay Steve Angello and a DJ set from indie electronic duo Bob Moses.

The lineup will also feature Danish/Egyptian DJ, producer and singer Ashibah, Brooklyn-based artist Eve Lauren and Copenhagen-based trio Tripolism. Organizers advise that “many more” artists will be added to the lineup in the coming months.

Registration to a ticket presale for We Belong Here’s October event is open now . As with previous editions in Central Park, the event will happen at the iconic Wollman Rink, which is set to transform into an ice skating rink a few weekends after We Belong Here.

This upcoming fall edition of We Below Here follows a summer edition of the fest that happened in June at Brooklyn Army Terminal. We Belong Here is also hosting a New Orleans edition at Goldring Woldenberg Riverfront Park on Nov. 13-15 with a lineup including Angello, Carl Cox, a DJ set from Odesza and Sammy Virji. We Belong Here then happens again at Miami’s Virginia Key Beach Park on Feb. 26-27, 2027, with the lineup to be announced.
